description: Re-runs L3 brief generation for a single brief (scoped to its cluster). Typically takes ~2–5 min. Async — returns `{operationId, status}`. Poll `get_job` with the operationId until `state` is `completed` (or `failed`/`partially_failed`/`cancelled` on error), then re-fetch with seo_get_brief to see the refreshed briefData. Use when the existing brief's outline is unusable and a structured seo_edit_brief won't recover it.
name: seo_regenerate_brief
